text: Uma's moving to Leeds at the end of the month. She's found a flat near the station but hasn't signed anything yet.
Coffee with Florin. He starts at the new firm sometime next week and is pretty nervous about it. Text him good luck the night before.
Chantal's daughter Isabel graduates in early July. Chantal is beyond proud and already planning a lunch for afterwards.
Tariq got the promotion! Team lead from November. Must send him a proper congratulations message tomorrow.
Asha has a flat viewing on Saturday morning in Walthamstow. She'll know by Monday whether the landlord accepts her offer.
Helen is retiring at Christmas after thirty-one years at the council. They're doing a leaving do the week before and I'm going.

Had a long call with Svetlana. Her son Bogdan sits his driving test on the 14th and is a nervous wreck. She is too, honestly. He failed the first attempt in the summer by clipping a kerb, so the pressure is on. She's taking the morning off work to drive him to the test centre and they're going out for breakfast afterwards whatever happens. Text Bogdan good luck the day before.
Need to book the van for the move and cancel the broadband sometime before the 30th.
Eli's first day of school was today. Apparently he cried at the gate and then didn't want to come home. Ask Jen how the rest of the week goes.
Luca and Hannah are moving to Bristol over the summer. Both of them have jobs lined up there already.
Reggie said his leaving drinks are cancelled because half the office has flu. He'll try again in the new year.
Angela mentioned she'd love a decent coffee grinder for the new flat. Good shout for a housewarming present.
Olga is starting her PhD in Edinburgh in late September. She's vegetarian and loves hill walking, so she's thrilled about the location.
Message from Jaya: her interview went really well and they want her back for a second round sometime next week.
I'm driving Amy to her new place on the Saturday and helping her unpack the day after.
Seo-yeon's sister Dana has her A-level results on Thursday. Seo-yeon says she's been sleeping badly for weeks.

Lunch with Imogen. She's handed in her notice and her last day is the end of next month. She's going freelance as an illustrator, which she's wanted to do for years. Her partner Joe is supportive but worried about money. Imogen still wants to do a small farewell thing at the pub afterwards. Remind me to ask her about the date nearer the time.
Pieter's new job in Rotterdam starts early March. He flies out the weekend before and his wife Abigail follows a month later with the kids.
Idris passed his exams! He's off to Manchester to study engineering in the autumn.

Rachel said the move fell through again. The buyers pulled out the morning of exchange. She's gutted and pretty exhausted by the whole thing. Must call her this weekend. She's already given notice on her rental, so if nothing turns up by the end of the month she'll be staying with her sister Uma for a bit, which neither of them is thrilled about.
Irina has a dog called Pickle who hates the car, so she's dreading the drive up to Inverness when they move next month.

Oliver and Liam got the keys to their first house yesterday! Housewarming sometime in November. Oliver's already planning to repaint everything, and Liam just wants a sofa. Their dog Rolo has claimed the garden.
Jen's eldest starts secondary school in September. Jen is more nervous than he is.
Note to self: renew the parking permit and post the meter readings before we move out.
Chantal Brennan, or Chan as everyone at work calls her, is moving to the Glasgow office in January. She's sad to leave but it's a step up.
Uma's dad retires on Friday. There's a family dinner that evening and she asked if I could make a cake. Don't forget to order the sponge on Wednesday.
Bumped into Tariq at the station. His wife Asha is about to start a new job at the hospital, nights to begin with.
Florin loves anything to do with old maps. Worth remembering for his birthday.
Helen's granddaughter has her first ballet exam in a couple of weeks. Helen's knitting her a cardigan for afterwards.

Spent the evening helping Adriana pack. She's moving to Lisbon in mid-October for a two-year contract with a design studio, and she still hasn't found anywhere to live. Her brother Luca is driving the van down with her and flying back a week after. She's excited but keeps saying she feels completely out of her depth. Text her the day she lands to see how she's settling in.
Svetlana's in the middle of a horrible job search. Six interviews, no offers. She's starting to lose confidence.
Reggie Evans from accounts is leaving on the 22nd. Collection going round; I should chip in by Wednesday.
Isabel's graduation photos came through. Her mum framed one for the hallway. Lovely.
Spoke to Hannah about her new role. She's head of year from January, which means more admin and less teaching.
Olga called. Her daughter starts nursery next Monday and they're doing half days for the first week. Olga is going back to work full time the week after.
Angela's son Oliver got into the music college he wanted. Audition was back in March, so they've been waiting ages.
Must remember to ask Jaya how the second interview went. It's sometime next week, probably Tuesday or Wednesday.
Sunday plans: tidy the spare room, sort the boxes from the loft, and take the old sofa to the tip.

Amy said her landlord is selling up, so she has to be out by the end of January. She's looking at places in Hove but everything is either tiny or miles away. She seemed really stressed. On top of that her new manager starts the same week, and her mum has been hinting that she should just move back home for a while. I said she could leave some boxes in our garage if it helps.

Dinner with Bogdan and his girlfriend Irina. They're both starting new jobs the same week in early November, him at a bank and her at the university library. Bogdan supports Arsenal and won't stop talking about it. Irina is gluten free. They've also just put an offer in on a flat in Crystal Palace and should hear sometime before Christmas.
Seo-yeon's last day at the agency was Friday. She's taking a month off before the new job. Send her that book on Korean cooking she mentioned.
Idris's little brother had his first swimming badge test today and passed. Idris was there cheering.
Remind me to call Pieter the day after he starts, just to see how it's going.
Abigail is selling the house in York and moving closer to her parents. Viewings start next week.
Imogen Zhou rang about the reunion. Turns out nobody can make the date, so it's been called off for now.
Jen and her husband are celebrating his promotion with a weekend away in Bath at the end of the month.
Grabbed a quick coffee with Joe. He's coaching the under-tens on Saturdays now and loves it.
Rachel's son Eli has his GCSE mocks in early December. He's been revising every night apparently.
Liam keeps hinting about wanting a proper toolbox for the new house. Could go in on it with Oliver for Christmas.

Luca's flat in Turin is finally sorted. He moves in on the 3rd and starts teaching the following Monday. He also mentioned that his mum isn't well, so he wants to be near her for a while. Should check in with him once he's settled, maybe early next month.
Tariq's daughter Uma passed her grade five piano exam. He sent a video of her playing afterwards.
Helen said the retirement party is now on the 12th, not the 5th. Venue's the same.
Asha is struggling at the new job. The manager is micromanaging everything and she dreads Mondays.
Called Mrs Petrov about the flat upstairs. Viewing is Thursday at six. I need to bring two months' deposit if I want it.
Chantal's boss is retiring in the spring and she's been asked to apply for his role. Interview is sometime in February.

Florin and his partner Dana are expecting their first baby in late April. They're also trying to move before then, which sounds chaotic. They've seen four places so far and Dana loved the one with the garden, but Florin thinks the commute would be awful once he starts the new role in January. Ask Florin how the second viewing goes on Saturday.
Got my start date confirmed: 2 December. First week is induction in the London office.

Adriana's first week in Lisbon has been a blur. She found a flat the day before her contract started and the office is lovely. Her cat Fig is apparently not impressed with the move. I should FaceTime her at the weekend.

Jaya's niece is starting university in Cardiff next week. Jaya's driving her down that morning and coming back the next day. Her sister is finding the empty nest bit hard already. Jaya says her niece wants to study medicine and is a huge Taylor Swift fan, so the room is apparently covered in posters before she's even unpacked the kettle. Send her a little good luck card before the first week.
Uncle Reggie turns seventy next month and also finally sold the shop. Big party planned for early spring.
